subject.title: [voice-call] OpenAI realtime: audio clipping / breaking inside words during first ~30s of outbound calls (Twilio mulaw output)

question: Should maintainers require fresh live-call/audio proof before changing the default Voice Call realtime telephony output pipeline for this report?
rationale: Source inspection narrows the path but does not identify a confirmed current-main root cause, and the obvious fixes could change realtime audio behavior for existing Voice Call users.

options.title: Require live proof first
options.body: Ask for or run a current-main/v2026.6.11 Twilio/OpenAI outbound call with audio capture plus peak/queue diagnostics before approving an audio-pipeline change.

options.title: Approve a guarded experiment
options.body: Allow a narrow PR that adds opt-in diagnostics or a controlled headroom experiment, but do not change defaults without before/after call proof.

options.title: Wait for reporter artifact
options.body: Keep the issue open until the reporter provides the offered audio sample or packet capture, then re-triage the exact failure mode.

recommendation.title: Require live proof first
recommendation.body: Ask for or run a current-main/v2026.6.11 Twilio/OpenAI outbound call with audio capture plus peak/queue diagnostics before approving an audio-pipeline change.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about the OpenAI realtime provider and Voice Call plugin boundary that steipete introduced and tuned in the relevant history.
